newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Pemex outlines natgas import levels.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Pemex outlines natgas import levels.

text.p: Mexico's state-owned oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) outlined Tuesday levels of natural gas imports through the border city of Reynosa.
A Pemex spokeswoman said that natural gas imports last week were "less than 70 million cubic feet per day" (cfd). She added the company predicted imports this week would average 22 million cfd.
The spokeswoman said Reynosa, which lies just on the Mexican side of the border with the U.S. state of Texas, was the only port of entry for natural gas.
